audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven chart rows disagree with the packet read and with this page's own why-texts — most obviously Level 1, which the chart calls Skill while whys[0] and content.early both open with 'Level 1 is Trundle's'.
audit.why: The mirror audit set the chart to Trundle / Skill / Skill / Skill / Swain / Swain / Skill in both layers, identical to the packet. Every row of that read matches the prose here: Trundle owns level 1 on the Chomp trade, 4-5 is an explicit cooldown standoff, Demonic Ascension takes 6, Liandry's takes first item, and whys[6] says to play short poke windows rather than all-ins late.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4, 5 and 6 moved to the mirror/packet read as matched pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Subjugate is described four times as 'Steals your stats' with no numbers, no cooldown, and no mention that the theft doubles.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount stolen is doubled.' It is 650 range on 120/100/80 — the same 650 as Demonic Ascension and the same 120s at rank 1, so the two ultimates are a direct trade and the player needs both numbers to decide who presses first. The doubling over 4 seconds is also why disengaging mid-Subjugate matters rather than riding it out.
audit.corrected: Steals health, armour and MR, doubling over 4 seconds; 120s at rank 1, same 650 range as your own R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pillar of Ice does not appear anywhere on the page, and Chomp's auto-reset is never mentioned.
audit.why: Pillar of Ice is a 1000-range impassable terrain pillar that also slows, on 21s at rank 1. Against a champion with no dash and a 650-range drain that ends when the target leaves, a wall dropped behind Swain is the whole kill setup — and the page tells the player nothing about it. Separately, the _missing-interactions entry flags 'Trundle's combo opens with an auto-attack reset (Chomp (Q)) — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the ability cast', and Chomp is only 300 range, which is closer than the page implies.
audit.corrected: Pillar of Ice walls your retreat from 1000 and slows; Chomp is a 300-range auto reset whose wind-up is the tell.
sources: champ-data/_kits/trundle.json (E range 1000, cd 21/19.5/18/16.5/15; Q range 300, autoReset)

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is listed in report[8] but no field explains why Frozen Domain makes the timing urgent.
audit.why: Frozen Domain grants 'increased healing from all sources while on it' — it is a healing amplifier, not just a speed zone, on 18s at rank 1 and 750 range. Combined with King's Tribute healing off every nearby unit death, Grievous Wounds is not a late luxury here, and fighting him while he stands on the domain is the specific mistake.
audit.corrected: Frozen Domain amplifies all his healing — buy Grievous Wounds early and never fight on top of it.
sources: champ-data/_kits/trundle.json (W text, range 750, cd 18/17/16/15/14; P King's Tribute)
